publisher_or_authors: Lightman, Kosaraju, Burda, et al. · OpenAI · 2023
summary: Finds process-level (step-by-step) supervision yields stronger verifier signals than outcome-only supervision in math reasoning. Strong verifiers can rank sampled trajectories and raise solved rates. Also flags that step-level checks can be gamed.
title: Let's Verify Step by Step
why: Core evidence that verifier design determines loop reliability.
